Dani, Sonnet Good news — I found several working resources on both topics: ## **Travel Advisor Ecosystem (Consortia & Commissions)** The consortium model works this way: vendors pay commissions to the **host agency** (as the "agency of record"), and the host agency then shares commissions with independent travel advisors. This structure lets smaller advisors access higher commission tiers through the host's collective buying power. Key players: **Virtuoso, Ensemble, Travel Leaders Network, Signature** — each negotiates exclusive rates with cruise lines and hotels. Commission splits typically range **70-90%** to established advisors, depending on volume and the host agency model. **Best working resources:** - [Travel Consortia: Full Guide (Altex)](https://www.altexsoft.com/blog

Dani, Sonnet Great question. Here's the structure of the travel advisor ecosystem: --- ## **Host Agencies vs. Consortia** **Host Agencies** are companies that employ or contract with travel advisors. They handle the business infrastructure (E&O insurance, supplier relationships, accounting) so advisors can focus on selling. **Consortia** are networks that member agencies join to gain leverage — pooled buying power, negotiated commissions, perks from suppliers. Hi Dani, when helping a client choose a cruise (they don't have a specific destination in mind or want to go somewhere new), where do you start? What questions do you ask?

Dani, Sonnet Great question. Here's how I approach it: **First, I listen for travel *style*, not just destination:** - "What does your ideal vacation feel like?" (Beach lounging? Cultural exploration? Fine dining focus? Active ports?) - "Have you cruised before? What did you love—or NOT love—about it?" - This tells me if they want a mega-ship party atmosphere vs. intimate expedition vs. luxury boutique experience. **Then I map *timing & rhythm*:*** - When do they want to travel? (Affects weather, crowds, pricing, ship rotation) - How long? (4 days? 10 days? Round-the-world?) - Any hard dates or seasons they're locked into? **I ask about *group dynamics*:*** - Who's traveling?
